question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Do you want to see a Super New Girl, Part 2?
Who was your favorite cheerleader to hang out with?

nodes.prompt: Maybe this isn't a good idea.

options.label: It'll be fun to see Amanda get all crazy!

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Maybe this isn't a good idea.

nodes.prompt: I need to come up with a counterattack, fast!

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: I need to come up with a counterattack, fast!

nodes.prompt: Is that a cool color for a dude to wear?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Is that a cool color for a dude to wear?

nodes.text: Only $SUPERZOE's arms become invisible!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: No hands or arms! This is cool!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: And slightly creepy...
She makes her arms come back into view then experiments with her legs.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: It'll be hard doing flips without legs, won't it?

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Good work, $SUPERZOE. Your powers are improving.
Super Power Level Up!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: They are, aren't they?
$SUPERZOE works hard for the rest of the afternoon, refining her control over her powers.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I almost have it down!
$SUPERZOE's hands return, and she sighs in relief.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Hey, girls. How's it going?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Pretty good, now that you three are around.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Taylor here was just telling me about the time she managed to stop a robbery from happening.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: She totally stopped the bandits' getaway car by standing in front of it in her diamond form!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wasn't that so awesome of me?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: That's pretty amazing, Taylor. I didn't know you were into stopping crime.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What can I say? Justice is my passion.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Hey, do you want to work for justice some time tonight after dinner?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Really? Yeah!
A minutes later, the boys take off to meet some friends.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, $SUPERZOE... Not bad. You stayed by my side, and helped me get a number!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If you stick with me all the time, I'll have my pick of all the hottest guys in school.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Nice work.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Hee hee. Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Taylor likes me!
$SUPERZOE forces herself to calm down and takes a deep breath.
Up in the air, she is able to enjoy how delightful the breeze feels in her hair, how stunning the lights of the city are, and how solid Howard's arms feel around her.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: This is fantastic. I can't believe you get to do this whenever you want.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't `wait` to see the look on your face when they vote me in instead of you.
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't [color=#3b78e2][i]wait[/i][/color] to see the look on your face when they vote me in instead of you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: For the first time in my life, I'm finally going to beat you at something, $SUPERZOE.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I guess we'll just have to see, won't we?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'll see you on the football field, 'cuz'. Better bring your A-game.
At last, it's Friday, and it's almost time for the cheerleading tryouts!
On the way to the field, $SUPERZOE runs into Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So... You ready for tryouts?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I guess so...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, before we head to the field later, there's one thing I want to say...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yes, it is...
$SUPERZOE turns to look into Howard's eyes.
He meets her eyes, as if searching for something but then looks away.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Thanks for taking me up here.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This was fun. But I should probably take you home now.
At the front door to $SUPERZOE's house...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Good night, Howard...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Good night, $SUPERZOE.
He turns and walks away.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I thought for sure he was going to kiss me. I wonder what happened...
$SUPERZOE squirms in Howard's grasp and starts kicking! She nearly falls forward, but Howard steadies her.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa! I got you! Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I... I just panicked. I didn't mean to kick you. Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm fine, but... I didn't realize you'd be so squeamish. I'm sorry you didn't enjoy this...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: No, I did! I mean, I `am` enjoying this...
nodes.text_bbcode: No, I did! I mean, I [color=#3b78e2][i]am[/i][/color] enjoying this...

nodes.text: $SUPERZOE takes a deep breath of air and looks out over the city.
Suddenly, $SUPERZOE gets a text from Howard!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: 'If you're free tonight, meet me at the cafe near the park.'

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: It's a date!
That night, $SUPERZOE and Howard meet for hot chocolate and take a stroll around the park.
Howard and $SUPERZOE talk about football, the cheerleading tryouts, and school as they finish drinking their hot chocolate.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: To make up for the last date... I want to show you something.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Here, step on my toes.
$SUPERZOE does so, while Howard puts an arm around her waist.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ready?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Where are we going?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Up.
Howard and $SUPERZOE zoom up, up, and away into the clouds.
Soon they are floating over the bright lights and tall buildings of the city.
$SUPERZOE looks down and suddenly feels panic overwhelm her!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: You want some help?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: From you? What would you possibly know about shooting fire at a target?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Not that much... But I was a geometry tutor back in middle school, and geometry is related to shooting targets.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Besides, it might be nice to practice my tutoring skills. So I don't get rusty...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well... Uh... If you need the practice, I guess so...
And an hour later...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're right, $SUPERZOE. I do flick my wrist when I shoot fireballs.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: You see? I think that throws off your aim. If you keep it more steady...
Sam sends forth a burst of flame that hits the target in the middle!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm going to practice more. I can take it from here.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And... Uh... Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Sure thing.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I owe you one...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But don't think this means I'm going to take it easy on you at tryouts. That spot is still going to be mine.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: We'll see...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Well... I wouldn't exactly call us 'friends' yet... But this is a real start!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Sorry, Sam, but fire? That's really not my thing.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, you're totally useless.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Exactly!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: See ya!
$SUPERZOE runs back home and closes the door to her room. Puddles crawls out from under her bed.

nodes.speaker: Puddles
nodes.text: I heard what you said to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Puddles
nodes.text: So, she could have used some pointers...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Don't tell me that.

nodes.speaker: Puddles
nodes.text: I'm just worried about your stuff. If she can't control her powers, it's not `my` stuff that's getting burned.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm just worried about your stuff. If she can't control her powers, it's not [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] stuff that's getting burned.

nodes.speaker: Puddles
nodes.text: And what if she takes out your shoes? What will I chew on then?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Puddles...

nodes.speaker: Puddles
nodes.text: You know that you two used to be friends.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Yeah, we `used` to. But she's the one who started this war. Let her get in trouble... I've got a cheerleading squad to join!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, we [color=#3b78e2][i]used[/i][/color] to. But she's the one who started this war. Let her get in trouble... I've got a cheerleading squad to join!

nodes.text: $SUPERZOE fades completely from view!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Hey, Taylor. How's it going?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Pretty good, now that you three are around. We really love company.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Who's 'we'?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: My friend...
Taylor looks beside her, but sees nothing.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $SUPERZOE, `where'd` you go?
nodes.text_bbcode: $SUPERZOE, [color=#3b78e2][i]where'd[/i][/color] you go?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Who are you talking to?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Wait, wait, I'm right here!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Whoa, did someone hear that? I think it's a ghost!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: A ghost?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Why would there be a ghost in here? It can't play pool!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Well, I'm not going to ask it!
The boys take off fast.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey, wait! I was just...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $SUPERZOE... Where are you?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I... I'm right here.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Look at what you did! You had `one` order, and that was to stay by my side!
nodes.text_bbcode: Look at what you did! You had [color=#3b78e2][i]one[/i][/color] order, and that was to stay by my side!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I was there the entire time... Just invisible.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Because that obviously worked `so` well...
nodes.text_bbcode: Because that obviously worked [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] well...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Next time, I'm calling `Amanda.` Shudder.
nodes.text_bbcode: Next time, I'm calling [color=#3b78e2][i]Amanda.[/i][/color] Shudder.

nodes.text: Taylor storms off, just as $SUPERZOE reappears.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I totally messed that one up...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You did great!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Nice work there...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: We'll be sure to put in a good word for you on Friday. That was awesome!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Thanks!
$SUPERZOE leaves the gym just as the class bell signaling the end of the day rings.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I've got Jill and Nicole... Now to work on Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You were awful.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Worst. Run. Ever.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Are you sure you're even super-powered?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Yours was worse than Sam's! At least Sam got through it with some style.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Though she did burn up the log and some of the robots... But still!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Style!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You should really just leave now.
$SUPERZOE leaves the gym just as the class bell signaling the end of the day rings.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Well, there goes Jill and Nicole... But I can still work on Taylor...
That afternoon, $SUPERZOE finds Taylor at the local billiards place...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Taylor, thanks for inviting me out! What are we going to...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Shh! I'm scoping out my target.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Your target?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: There!
$SUPERZOE and Taylor spot a trio of very cute guys across the room.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I was thinking of going for Phil... The one in the middle?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Ooh, he's so cute!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: As if I'd ever go for anyone else.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Are you going to ask him out?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Of course. But I can't do it alone. It'll make me look desperate.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's where you come in. You're my wing-woman.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: What do I do?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Don't `ever` leave my side. Got it?
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't [color=#3b78e2][i]ever[/i][/color] leave my side. Got it?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Yeah!
$SUPERZOE follows as Taylor walks up to Phil, Jacob, and Zach.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Okay, I've got this. All I have to do is stay near Taylor and talk to those really cute guys...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: No reason to be nervous...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Uh-oh!
$SUPERZOE looks down at her hands. They're nearly translucent.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I'm disappearing! Professor Doom never told me what to do if I was having trouble reappearing!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I guess I have to think solid!
$SUPERZOE turns invisible just as the turret turns its eye on her.
It moves past her.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Whew! I'm glad that worked!
She sprints past the laser and crosses the finish line, appearing right in front of Jill and Nicole!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: How'd I do?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Overall...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: `Ahhhhhhh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ahhhhhhh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: $SUPERZOE makes a sprint for the end of the obstacle course!
The laser shoots a beam right at her feet! The explosion flings $SUPERZOE into the air!
She rolls lamely across the finish line, landing unceremoniously in front of Jill and Nicole!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: How'd I do?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: If we ignore this last part...
$SUPERZOE shakes herself free of the robots and starts sprinting down the clear causeway to the finish line!
And that's when a laser turret pops out of the ground and starts shooting laser blasts in her direction!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Seriously? Why? Who pays for this?!
She hides behind a nearby pillar.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: What should I do?!
She looks out from behind the pillar, but the laser turret swivels toward her and fires!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: `Ahhhhh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ahhhhh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: She rolls away, ducking behind another pillar.
$SUPERZOE makes a dive for the pipe, grabs it, and rolls back onto her feet.
Armed with the pipe, she swings and bats at the robots until she makes her way through to the other side!
$SUPERZOE freezes!
The first robot comes up to her and attempts to hit her!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I need to move!
She dives behind some crates along the edge and crawls her way to the other side while the robots search for her.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Not the most elegant way to get through this...
On the other side of the pit, $SUPERZOE finds herself in a large arena.
A platoon of robots suddenly springs up around her.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Uh-oh...
She spots a metal pipe to one side of the arena...
She falls to the side and off the log!
She lands in knee-deep water.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Ewww...
She looks up at Jill and Nicole who are shaking their heads.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Keep going!
She falls to the side and off the log!
She lands in knee-deep water.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Ewww...
She looks up at Jill and Nicole who are shaking their heads.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Keep going!
She manages to balance on the log and inches slowly forward...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Slowly... Slowly...
Until at last she reaches the other side!
$SUPERZOE steps up to the next platform where a log is set up between two platforms over a small lake of water.
She takes a tentative step on the log. It starts rolling in place, throwing her off balance!
She falls down, hurtling towards the spikes in the pit!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: So promising...
Jill pulls a lever next to her, and a door over the pit slides closed.
$SUPERZOE hits the ground, unhurt. She dusts herself off.
She tightens her grip just enough for her to swing to the other side and jump off to safe ground.
She falls down, hurtling towards the spikes in the pit!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: So promising...
Jill pulls a lever next to her, and a door over the pit slides closed.
$SUPERZOE hits the ground, unhurt. She dusts herself off.
Before her is a long pit of spikes. $SUPERZOE notices a rope to one side.
She grabs hold of the rope and starts to swing across when...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I'm slipping down the rope!
$SUPERZOE rolls forward, the blade missing her by inches!
She gets to her feet and runs to the next section.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Nice!
$SUPERZOE freezes in place, terrified!
Up in the bleachers, Nicole snaps her fingers, and the knife blade disappears!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Keep going!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I'm really going to have to step up my game...
She heads for the next section.
Suddenly, the machine starts vibrating and making sounds.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Uh-oh...
`Thwack! Thwack! Thwack!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Thwack! Thwack! Thwack![/b]

nodes.text: $SUPERZOE blocks them all!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Take that! Ha!
Super Power Level Up!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Did you see that?

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Very good. That will be all for today.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: `Ahhh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ahhh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: $SUPERZOE gets pelted by all three tennis balls!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Ow ow ow...

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Are you all right?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I'm fine... Just... I think I broke my nose... Ow...

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Why don't you see the nurse?
At the nurse's office...
The school counselor Ms. Lee touches $SUPERZOE's nose.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Ow!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Yep. That's broken.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Are you sure?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Not really. In fact, I have no medical training whatsoever!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: You don't? Then why are you a nurse?
Ms. Lee leans forward and touches $SUPERZOE's nose. She feels a tingling sensation... And then her nose feels all better!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: That `is` a good reason!
nodes.text_bbcode: That [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] a good reason!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: But broken or not... Take this ice pack and wear it for awhile.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: You know a pretty girl like you should really refrain from these types of activities.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Using your super powers can only lead to trouble.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Oh, why's that?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: My mother always says that no man likes it when his girlfriend can lift more trucks than he can...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Right... Uh, thanks for the ice pack, Ms. Lee... I'm going to go...
$SUPERZOE runs out of the nurse's office.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Well, that just made me want to work on my powers `more...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, that just made me want to work on my powers [color=#3b78e2][i]more...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Someday, I `will` get that shield to work!
nodes.text_bbcode: Someday, I [color=#3b78e2][i]will[/i][/color] get that shield to work!

nodes.text: After lunch, $SUPERZOE checks her schedule and finds herself with a free study period.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: This is my last day to really make an impression on the cheerleaders before tryouts... I'm going to have to really step it up.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I wonder where I can find Jill and Nicole...
In the gym, $SUPERZOE finds an elaborate obstacle course!
The obstacle course is made of spike pits, angry automatons, swinging blades, and giant rolling boulders.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Wow... This looks like a pretty `dangerous` room!
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow... This looks like a pretty [color=#3b78e2][i]dangerous[/i][/color] room!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Uh, Jill? Nicole? Anyone here?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Hey, you're the new girl, right?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Yeah, I have a free period. Do you girls want to hang out?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Listen, if you want our favor for the cheerleading squad, then all you have to do is prove one thing to us.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: You have to prove your worth on the field of battle! In a fight to the death!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Oh, that sounds scary...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Just kidding! You just have to pass this obstacle course. I built it mostly myself.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: It's my super power, you know. I'm a technocraft. See?
Jill pats a robotic dog sitting next to her. It barks.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hey, I helped build the course too. I have the power to create things with my mind.
Nicole snaps a finger, and what looks like a holographic makeup compact comes into being. She grabs it and powders her nose.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: That's cool!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Anyway, our obstacle course should tell us everything we need to know about how smart, powerful, and quick on your feet you are!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: No pressure or anything...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Are you ready?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Bring it.
$SUPERZOE steps up to the line where the obstacle course starts.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Go!
$SUPERZOE rushes forward...
And a gigantic knife blade comes swinging down towards her!
The tennis ball bounces off her shield.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: That was close!
$SUPERZOE doesn't get her shield up in time... She throws herself to the side.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: That was way too close...
$SUPERZOE readies herself for the next wave...
Thwack! A tennis ball barrels straight at $SUPERZOE!
The ball thumps her arm hard!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Ow!
The ball bounces harmlessly off her shield!
$SUPERZOE readies herself for the next round...
Thwack! A tennis ball shoots out at her!
$SUPERZOE throws her hands out in front of her, and a shield materializes at her fingertips!
She successfully deflects the ball!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I did it!
$SUPERZOE reacts too slowly!
The ball hits her knee!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Oh!
$SUPERZOE reacts too slowly!
The ball hits her knee!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Oh!
On Thursday morning...
$SUPERZOE approaches Professor Doom.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Professor Doom, something happened yesterday while I was at the ice cream parlor.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I was able to create a shield or something!

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: This is good to hear. It means you're becoming more comfortable with your powers.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Your task for today is to summon that shield, so you can use it in a time of need.
Professor Doom sets $SUPERZOE in front of a tennis ball machine.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: This machine will throw tennis balls at you at different speeds. Try to use your shield to block what comes your way.
$SUPERZOE faces the tennis ball machine.
Thwack! The machine shoots a ball at her!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: So... What are you saying? That I should give up?

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: Of course not!

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: But I do wish you'd try a little harder to be nice to her. She's your only cousin... And the only one you'll ever have.
Aunt Cathy cleans up the photos and leaves to put the box away.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Great... Now I just feel bad.
Puddles comes over and licks her hand.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: What do you think I should do, huh, boy?

nodes.speaker: Puddles
nodes.text: I find the answer to all questions is to give your favorite dog a good rubdown.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Ha ha, I was talking about Sam, but you make a compelling case...
$SUPERZOE pets Puddles and scratches his ears.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Still, what should I do?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: How am I supposed to be nice to Sam when she's always picking fights with me?!

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: That may be so...

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: I `have` raised quite a stubborn daughter.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] raised quite a stubborn daughter.

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: I'm just not sure if losing her cheerleading spot to you is going to help matters.

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: Sam just wants `so` badly to be accepted, to be a winner...
nodes.text_bbcode: Sam just wants [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] badly to be accepted, to be a winner...

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: I hope she gets that chance.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry this wasn't the best date. But give me another chance.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll come up with something good next time.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I'm sure I can squeeze something in between all my cheerleading.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You name the time.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Hee hee.
That night at home, $SUPERZOE sits with Aunt Cathy and Puddles...

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: So... You still haven't talked with Sam about your issues, have you?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Er... Not exactly.

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: I can sense her anxiety and your confusion over it.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Well, it's kind of hard to talk when we're in the middle of competing for this cheerleading spot.

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: I want you to remember, $SUPERZOE... Just because you're competing with Sam doesn't mean you have to `hate` her.
nodes.text_bbcode: I want you to remember, $SUPERZOE... Just because you're competing with Sam doesn't mean you have to [color=#3b78e2][i]hate[/i][/color] her.

nodes.text: Puddles nudges a box towards Aunt Cathy and $SUPERZOE.

nodes.speaker: Puddles
nodes.text: Aunt Cathy, I found them...

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: Good fetch, Puddles!
She pets his head and takes a stack of photos out of the box.

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: Maybe you should take a look at some of these...
$SUPERZOE looks at the old photos. There's one of a group of little girls on the beach. $SUPERZOE stands in the middle, smiling.
Alone, to one side of the picture, Sam is standing, sulking.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I remember that... We all went to the beach with Sam's friends. I was the one who found shells for all the girls because Sam...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Well, Sam kept flaming up and drying out the tide pools she played in...

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: She also didn't know how to swim.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Oh yeah... I forgot.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Oh! And here's a photo of us playing chess when we were a little older. I won every game!

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: I remember... And I also remember Sam throwing fireballs because she always lost.

nodes.speaker: Puddles
nodes.text: Poor Sam...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Shoot... I guess I never realized how it felt to lose every game.

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: It's never been easy for Sam... She's struggled with school and with sports...

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: And you know she got her powers at a young age... Other little girls were scared of her until she learned to control them.

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: Think how it must feel for her to have a cousin like you show up out of nowhere and try out for her cheerleading spot.

nodes.prompt: Think how it must feel for her to have a cousin like you...

options.label: That's no excuse for her behavior.
I never thought of it that way.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Think how it must feel for her to have a cousin like you...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's that girl... Linda. She and I used to date.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, that's all ancient history, okay? It's just one of those awkward break ups.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Well, thanks for telling me. I guess the two of you used to come here together?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: So... Uh... You okay?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No. Yes. Never mind. Let's just forget about it. Ready to go?
As $SUPERZOE stands up, she nearly runs into the couple! Strawberry ice cream spills all over $SUPERZOE's shoes!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Whoa! Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $SUPERZOE, are you all right?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Yeah... I guess pink isn't a bad color for these shoes.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Where's an invisible force field when you need it, huh?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard? I... Didn't realize the two of you were together.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We were just leaving.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No, no. Kenji and I aren't staying.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Right...
Kenji and Linda awkwardly leave the cafe.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: So, I'm guessing that's your ex-girlfriend?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That obvious, huh?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Well, it was that awkward.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're right, that was pretty bad.
Just then, $SUPERZOE sees a couple walk into the ice cream parlor, carrying pastries.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hey, Kenji, let's get some strawberry ice cream to go with this strawberry pastry!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's her!
Howard knocks over his milkshake in panic!
As if in slow motion, $SUPERZOE can see the milkshake slowly tip over!
$SUPERZOE reacts, throwing her hands in front of her!
Immediately, an invisible force field stops the milkshake from spilling and contains it!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $SUPERZOE? What was that?
Super Power Acquired!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I... I'm not sure. I think I created a shield or something!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks for saving my shirt.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Literally.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Of course.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: He looked so shaken up when he saw that girl Linda... I want to ask about it...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: But I don't want to bring it up if he's going to be upset...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No way. I don't know how to handle them now.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It'd be even worse if there were hundreds of them!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's a dark future I'd like never to think about.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Whoops... Wrong thing to say, I guess...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ha ha, that would be awesome!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They'd be so tall.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And I bet they'd be easier to handle too. `Two` twins are tough. One of them, even superpowered, I can handle.
nodes.text_bbcode: And I bet they'd be easier to handle too. [color=#e23b3b][i]Two[/i][/color] twins are tough. One of them, even superpowered, I can handle.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Glad that made you smile.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Hopefully they'll work things out!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: And if they do, I hope Hector remembers `who` encouraged him to talk to Amanda!
nodes.text_bbcode: And if they do, I hope Hector remembers [color=#3b78e2][i]who[/i][/color] encouraged him to talk to Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I really hope things work out for them...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: And if they don't, I hope Hector doesn't remember that it was `my` idea to talk to Amanda.
nodes.text_bbcode: And if they don't, I hope Hector doesn't remember that it was [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] idea to talk to Amanda.

nodes.text: Suddenly $SUPERZOE's phone beeps! She picks it up.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, if you're not busy... Do you want to go out and get some milkshakes?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Yes!
A little bit later, $SUPERZOE meets Howard at an ice cream parlor near the school. The two of them grab milkshakes and sit at one of the tables.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's really strange how you and Sam are so different. If I didn't know better, I wouldn't believe the two of you are cousins.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Heh. I guess genetics don't count for as much as you'd think. What about your family? Any brothers or sisters?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, I've got siblings all right. Two little twin terrors, Kay and Kel.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Aww, twin sisters? They sound adorable!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You wouldn't say that if you knew them! They're serious troublemakers.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Two years ago, they opened a transdimensional portal to the Shadow World in my closet.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And the year after that, they turned my laptop into a kill-crazy robot that seriously messed up my room.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Wow! Sounds like they have some pretty destructive powers!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh no... They don't have powers yet. They're just... Really good at pranks...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm a little afraid to think of what will happen when they `do` receive their super powers.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm a little afraid to think of what will happen when they [color=#e23b3b][i]do[/i][/color] receive their super powers.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: It depends on what they get. What if they could...
$SUPERZOE tackles Hector and pushes him into a nearby bush!
Amanda stands up and looks back.
$SUPERZOE turns invisible!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hello?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hmmm... Nothing's there.
Amanda turns back to the squirrel. $SUPERZOE finds kitten Hector in the brush, and they hide behind a tree.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Hector, are you okay?
Hector turns back into a normal human.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What did you do that for?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I wanted to stop you from making a mistake. Don't just jump to conclusions.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Are you `sure` Amanda isn't just talking to a regular squirrel?
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you [color=#3b78e2][i]sure[/i][/color] Amanda isn't just talking to a regular squirrel?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Actually... Now that we're closer, it does look more 'regular' than 'super'...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: See?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah. Thanks for tackling me, $SUPERZOE. Fighting with a squirrel probably would've upset Amanda a lot.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I guess I'll go over and talk to her now.
Hector walks over.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Amanda...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector, you found me!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Amanda... Listen... About me turning into a kitten...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I know it makes you happy, and I love to do things you like... But I don't want to be a kitten `all the time`...
nodes.text_bbcode: I know it makes you happy, and I love to do things you like... But I don't want to be a kitten [color=#e23b3b][i]all the time[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh, I didn't know that... I'm sorry. I don't want you to change into something you don't want to be just for me.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, I don't mind changing `some` of the time...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I don't mind changing [color=#e23b3b][i]some[/i][/color] of the time...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Awww, I love you, Hecky-Wecky!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I love you too, Manda-Panda!
They hug each other and walk off, talking happily.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I'm so happy I helped them!
$SUPERZOE stops in her tracks.
Hector the Kitten pounces on the squirrel, grabs it by the scruff of its neck, and hurls it across the clearing.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh no! No! What are you doing?
Hector turns back into human form.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Getting rid of your new `pet!`

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I know what's happening here. You're trying to replace me!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: That's not it at all!
Amanda rushes forward and cradles the squirrel in her arms.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Mr. Squirrel was just hungry! I was feeding him, and you attacked him for no reason!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh! Uh... I see.
Hector squints at the squirrel.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That is an ordinary squirrel...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Gee... I wish `someone` had stopped me before I pounced on him...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Gulp!
Amanda glares at Hector angrily.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You could have hurt him! I'm going home right now to take care of him!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Amanda, I...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: No. Don't talk to me. Don't even look at me! I'm so mad at you!
Amanda storms away, as Hector follows shouting apologies.
From the bushes, $SUPERZOE watches them leave.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: That could have gone way better... But at least they're kind of talking...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: You know, she told me something the other day...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: She said she was worried that you didn't care about her anymore since you've been so distant.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: You should really talk to her.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You think that'll work?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Of course. Ferocious animals can be really cute.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Haven't you ever seen a stuffed animal?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: They make all sorts of dangerous and powerful animals into cute plush toys.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: If I can convince her of that... She'll let me be whatever I want!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Glad I could help.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Tell her exactly what you told me.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Even if kittens are cute...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Being a kitten is limiting and exhausting.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That is...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: A `terrible` idea.
nodes.text_bbcode: A [color=#e23b3b][i]terrible[/i][/color] idea.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I can't tell her that whenever she asks me to become a kitten or a unicorn, I cringe a little inside!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: You can become a unicorn?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's not the point.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The `real` point is you don't want to see Amanda when she feels guilty.
nodes.text_bbcode: The [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] point is you don't want to see Amanda when she feels guilty.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: She can't live with the idea that she's made anyone or anything sad!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: 'Anything'?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: She crushed a daisy once, and she felt so badly that she levitated everywhere for a week!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: What's the matter?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Does this have to do with why you had to sneak out of the library so quickly?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Kinda.
They roll on their sides to face each other.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: My power is shapeshifting. I can turn into any animal I want.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But Amanda keeps wanting me to turn into cute, cuddly animals.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Kittens, puppies, squirrels...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I love all those things!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So does she. And I don't mind doing it for her, but at some point, it just gets a little limiting.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I don't want to spend the rest of my life as a kitten!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm just not sure what to do.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Have you tried telling her?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I did. Kind of. I told her, 'Amanda, kittens just aren't that cute.'

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Well, you're going to lose `that` argument. Amanda `loves` kittens!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, you're going to lose [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] argument. Amanda [color=#3b78e2][i]loves[/i][/color] kittens!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: What if you told her...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: See? It's haunches are right there, and that little cirrus cloud is like its whisker...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh, right.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Of course you'd see `that.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course you'd see [color=#e23b3b][i]that.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Girls only ever want to see cute things.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Well, sorry for sharing.
Hector sighs.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sorry, $SUPERZOE. Things have been weird with Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You see it too?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I thought it might have been wishful thinking.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: No way! That gigantic part in the middle is its torso...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And that little cirrus cloud is a claw from its paw, am I right?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And over there is a fish that it's going to eat alive!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Okay, I was with you until that point.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm just glad you saw the bear. I was afraid you'd think it was a cute kitten or something.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Do you have something against kittens?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No... It's just things have been weird with Amanda.
$SUPERZOE tries her best to make her arms disappear...
But only manages to get her right leg to vanish!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: That wasn't what I wanted. Let's try again.
$SUPERZOE tries harder....

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Yeah! My right arm disappeared!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: ...But so did my left foot.
$SUPERZOE tries again...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: My left arm is gone... But so is my right leg!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Um, would you mind `not` doing that? It's kind of freaking me out...
nodes.text_bbcode: Um, would you mind [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] doing that? It's kind of freaking me out...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You're like a monster!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: ...Right.
$SUPERZOE works hard for the rest of the afternoon, trying to get the right body parts to disappear.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Oh well, I'm sure it'll come eventually...

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Your basics could use more work. Try concentrating on something small today.
It's Wednesday morning, and $SUPERZOE is in Super Powers class.
We hope you enjoyed our spin-off story, the Super New Girl!

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: So far you've been turning your entire body invisible.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Today, work on turning only parts of yourself invisible.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Start with the left hand, then the left arm. The right hand, then the right arm.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: If that comes easily or if you've mastered that, try making your legs disappear.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Okay. I'll work on it!
$SUPERZOE begins her exercises.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I need to make certain parts of my body invisible. Hands and arms first!
$SUPERZOE glances around the room. In one corner, Sam is making small fire bursts...
And she almost sets Hannah's hair on fire!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Sam! You almost burned me... `Again!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sam! You almost burned me... [color=#3b78e2][i]Again![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry... I'm still trying to figure things out...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Well, figure them out over there... By yourself!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I wonder if I should go over and help her...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Even if we're competing, we `are` family...
nodes.text_bbcode: Even if we're competing, we [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] family...

nodes.text: $SUPERZOE starts to wander over... But Jessica and Maria walk up to Sam first!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't bother with Hannah. She's always complaining about something.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You have nothing to worry about! Soon, you'll be a cheerleader!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Of course I will! It's not like there's any `real` competition out there right now...
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course I will! It's not like there's any [color=#3b78e2][i]real[/i][/color] competition out there right now...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Never mind what I was just thinking... I'm `definitely` going to make the team!
nodes.text_bbcode: Never mind what I was just thinking... I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]definitely[/i][/color] going to make the team!

nodes.text: $SUPERZOE works harder than ever on her powers.
When class ends, she's exhausted!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Glad that's over! I worked up a sweat!
After school, $SUPERZOE finds Hector in the library hiding behind a bookcase.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Hi, Hector! I was just looking for you!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Shh! Not so loud!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Oh! What's wrong?
Hector peers around the bookcase to where Amanda and Taylor are talking. He ducks back behind it quickly.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's just... Never mind.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You said you were looking for me?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I wanted to hang out with you. Are you free after school?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Want to leave now?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Okay! Where should we go?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Anywhere but here.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Actually, I have an idea! But we need to get out of here quickly and when Amanda's not looking...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Why...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Shhh!
Hector leaves the shelter of the bookshelves, looks around, then rushes for the library door, pushing $SUPERZOE in front of him.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Go go go!
An hour later, Hector and $SUPERZOE sit in the grass around a lake.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's beautiful out here, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: It really is.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It reminds of my uncle's cabin. He had one in the woods. You know... Before the Space Hamster invasion.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Of course.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We used to go out, and sometimes he'd look for shapes in the clouds with me.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Want to try it?
They lie down on the grass and look up at the sky. It's filled with light, fluffy clouds.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: See that one over there?
$SUPERZOE looks at an especially large one to her right.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What does that look like to you?
$SUPERZOE squints at it.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: That looks like a kitten sitting down... Or a bear making a scary face...

nodes.prompt: What does that look like to you?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What does that look like to you?

nodes.text: On the way back home...
$SUPERZOE passes by the training fields in the back of the school.
Sam is there, using the indestructible targets for target practice.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Stupid... Targets!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Stupid... Targets![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Uh, is everything okay?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Does it look okay?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Professor Doom says that if I can't hit the center five times in a row, he's going to make me go to study hall every day until I can control myself.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He's crazy. I control myself perfectly!
Sam throws her hands down in disgust, and two twin balls of fire punch themselves into the ground.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Right...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Maybe I should stay and help her...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe

args.text: He's so cute!
If I'm going to see him every week, I'd better get on the cheerleading team!
And that means making friends with cheerleaders like... Keith!
$SUPERZOE calls Keith.
Good to hear from you, $SUPERZOE. I'm just about to go check out a movie. You want to come?
Sounds like fun!
$SUPERZOE meets Keith outside a movie theater.
Thanks for meeting up with me! I've been wanting to check out `Breaking Dusk: The Really Long Wedding` for weeks.
Really? We don't have to see some stupid, sappy vampire romance just because I'm a girl.
I actually wouldn't mind checking out 'Ninja Party!' I like ninjas, and I `love` parties!
But... Breaking Dusk...
Er... Fine. Breaking Dusk, it is.
While waiting for the movie to start...
Hey, I'm kind of looking for some advice.
Sure. What's up?
Well, I'm redesigning my superhero costume, and I'm trying to figure out what colors I should use.
Red, white, and blue always seem to be popular.
This might seem weird, but I'm actually thinking about going with purple.
Is that, you know, a cool color for a dude to wear?
Make your choice!
Sure, guys can rock purple.|Isn't purple a little girly?
Is that a cool color for a dude to wear?
Haha! Totally... I was just kidding! I'd `never` do that!
Why didn't I just go with 'pink'? That would have been a much better joke.
Uh... Are you okay?
I'm doing awesome. I just, uh, really don't want to miss anything in the movie...
Oh look! It's starting.
But those are just the ads before the movie plays.
I `said` I didn't want to miss anything.
They sit in silence until the movie actually starts.
Shoot... `That` didn't go well.
I'm totally going to do it!
And if you pair that purple with black, it'll make you look dark and mysterious.
I like it.
You know, just because I cheer, and I have immaculately gelled hair, and I wear designer jeans doesn't mean I'm less of a man!
People think that just because a guy happens to know the lyrics to a few musicals, he can't kick a little butt from time to time.
Hehe. I don't think I've ever seen you this mad.
I don't like people to know it gets to me... But now I know I can trust you.
Thanks, $SUPERZOE. You're a good friend.
Oh, look! The movie's starting!
An hour later, $SUPERZOE and Keith are plunged into the story of a romance between a vampire and the human he loves.
On the screen...
I... I just don't know if I can be with you. My heart belongs to another...
I understand...
Uh... Wait. I didn't tell you to put your shirt back on.
Whatever you say, babe.
But if we're going to part ways forever... Can we at least make out for a couple minutes?
Yes, I thought you'd never ask!
Finally! Here it is! Their big scene!
At that moment, two large guys stumble into the theater and sit in front of $SUPERZOE and Keith, blocking their view!
Good one, Steve. We can't get caught now. They're never going to think two boys are sneaking into Breaking Dusk on purpose.
Yeah!
Hey! You two are blocking our view of the movie.
And it's the best part too!
And what are you going to do about it?
We're going to report you. It sounds like you snuck into this theater, and I'm going to tell the manager.
And what if we don't want to leave?
Keith punches his palm.
What do you think?
Ha, yeah right! I'd like to see you try!
Keith extends his arms out and double punches Darren in the face! Darren goes down!
Darren!
Steve turns to $SUPERZOE and makes a grab at her.
What do you do?!
Stay in sight!|Stay in sight!|Turn invisible!|Stay in sight!
Decide fast!
$SUPERZOE does nothing! Steve grabs her!
Oh!
Keith tries to punch Steve, but stops short, realizing that $SUPERZOE is in the way.
At that moment, the manager barges into the theater with two security guards.
There they are! The kids who keep disrupting everyone's movies! And they've got friends!
No way you're taking me down!
Steve steps back and throws his hands out! Immediately, he starts inflating, like a large balloon!
Bye, suckers!
He floats to the ceiling and smoothly sails out of the theater...
He's getting away!
At least he's out of the theater. Which is where all of you are going too!
The security guards haul Darren, Keith, and $SUPERZOE out of the theater.
No! Wait! We weren't the ones who...
And stay out!
I can't believe I'm missing this movie! Right now, we could be watching a wedding!
I'm sorry about what happened, Keith. Maybe we can catch the movie again some other time.
I guess.
He looks so sad... I wish I had turned invisible when I had the chance!
Come on, let's just go home.
I'll walk you.
$SUPERZOE turns invisible and ducks out of Steve's grasp!
Try to find me now!
What? Where'd she go?
Keith punches Steve, but he dodges!
Steve throws his arms out and immediately starts inflating like a balloon! He floats above their heads...
Just try reaching me now!
Keith spins and kicks his leg out. It extends all the way up to Steve, slamming into him and making him ricochet against the theater walls!
Steve falls out of the air and slumps down next to Darren.
Together, $SUPERZOE and Keith pick up Steve and Darren and dump them outside the theater.
And stay out!
That's for making me miss the best part of the movie!
The theater manager runs up to them.
We've been trying to get rid of these boys all day.
The manager hands Keith and $SUPERZOE a stack of free movie tickets! After the manager thanks them one more time, he leaves.
Keith turns to $SUPERZOE.
Come on, $SUPERZOE, I'll walk you home.
So you're telling me that the novel Breaking Dusk ends with the couple getting married despite the lunar apocalypse?
`And` despite the ongoing war between vampires and werewolves.
All weddings should end in epic battles to the death!
Ha ha. I guess.
I'm sorry you weren't able to see all that in movie form.
It's okay. That was the most fun way to cut a movie date short.
I mean... Not that this is a date or anything!
I... I have a girlfriend.
Oh...
...But she lives in Canada.
And, uh, honestly, $SUPERZOE... I don't feel too comfortable talking about Chelsea with you.
Why's that?
It's just... $SUPERZOE, even though we didn't get to finish the movie, I had a lot of fun with you. Being with you makes me think... Never mind.
I'd rather not talk to you about this...
What does that mean? Does Keith like me?
Let's just discuss something else, okay?
In front of $SUPERZOE's house...
Well, this is it. Thanks for coming out with me.
It was a ton of fun! You're a great date!
Even though it's not a date!
So are you.
Keith leans in.
Does... Does he want me to kiss him?
What do you do?!
Kiss him!
Decide fast!
...Sorry, I know I'm being a little confusing.
The truth is, I think you're really awesome.
But I'm not the kind of guy who could just cheat on someone.
Even though Chelsea is far away... I still really care about her.
Aw... You're a really sweet guy, Keith.
Chelsea is lucky to have you.
Keith extends his arms out and wraps them twice around $SUPERZOE, giving her a super hug!
Thanks for understanding.
And just so you know... If I wasn't with Chelsea, I'd ask you out in a second.
Well... It's not as good as actually scoring a date...
But I actually feel pretty good about my friendship with Keith!
$SUPERZOE leans forward and presses her lips to Keith's!
Mmm...
Mmm...
Mmm!
Keith pulls away suddenly, and $SUPERZOE can see his lips stretching and expanding...
Keith? What's wrong?
Mrrrph! Mrph mrrrrph!
Keith, I can't understand you when your mouth is... On the ground... Eww...
Keith pulls himself together.
Is something wrong? What were you saying earlier?
I said, we kissed! That means I cheated on my girlfriend!
Come on... The 'different area code' rule `definitely` applies here. She doesn't even live in this `country!`
But she still lives in the area code of my heart! The little area code inside my chest that beats only for her!
I guess kissing Keith was a mistake...
I... I'm really sorry. This has nothing to do with you...
And I still want us to be able to hang out in school and on the team and stuff...
But you need to understand that my heart belongs only to my Canadian Snowflake, my Chelsea-Bear...
Uh... Okay. I'm going to get out of here.
...Before I throw up.

At the end of the day, $SUPERZOE is gathering her books from her locker when Howard walks up!
Hey. You're $SUPERZOE, right?
That's right. And of course I remember you. Everyone knows who you are.
Heh. You mean the whole footbrawl thing? It's pretty cool being the star player, but it's not everything. It does take up a lot of time.
But hey, if you make the cheerleading squad, I guess I'll be seeing you every week.
Well, maybe we don't have to wait for you to make the squad. Why don't you give me a call when you're free, and we can go get milkshakes at this great place down the street.
Howard rips a piece of paper out of his notebook and writes his number down.
O... Okay!
See you later, $SUPERZOE.
$SUPERZOE drops her invisibility!

$SUPERZOE practices really hard for the entire afternoon and manages to hold her invisibility up for one more second.
She drops it exhausted.
Geez. I wish this were easier...
At lunch, $SUPERZOE spots Sam and Taylor talking in the corner of the cafeteria.
Taylor, your super powers are so awesome.
Not everyone can create body shields as hard as diamonds that `also` glitter!
Who else has powers that are so fashionable?
Well, aren't you fun to have around? Go on.
Don't get me started on your costume...
It looks hot on you!
This is just pathetic! I need to come up with a counterattack, fast!
Make your choice!
Compliment Taylor.|Insult Sam.
I need to come up with a counterattack, fast!
What would you know about powers, Sam? You can't even control yours!
Uh... What does that have to do with anything? At least Sam can do cool things with her powers.
If I recall, you couldn't even use yours at practice.
I just meant... I was just saying...
Tell you what, `Sam.` Why don't you give me a call sometime. We can work on our powers together.
That would be `great!`
Shoot... That was really bad. Now I'm going to have to try `extra` hard to get Taylor to like me!
That means that it's extra important I get in with the other cheerleaders!
I like your costume, too... But it wouldn't look as good on a different girl.
White compliments your skin tone really well!
Good point, $SUPERZOE!
You two are both so sweet. We should hang out sometime!
Tell you what... Let me give you my number!
Thanks, Taylor!
And good to see `you`, $SUPERZOE...
Same to you, 'cuz'.
Nice! Now I can hang out with Taylor!
But first... I need to get to know the other cheerleaders!
In Basic Strategies Class, $SUPERZOE approaches Hector and Amanda.
Uh... Hey, guys. Mind if I sit down?
Yeah, I was just leaving. I have another class right now.
Before you go, can you turn into a kitten for me again?
Right now? Mr. Sprinkles likes to take breaks...
Please?
Hector squares his shoulders, takes a deep breath, then...
Turns into a cute, cuddly kitten!
Purrr purrr...
Squee! You're so pretty, Mr. Sprinkles... So pretty and furry! You're so much prettier than Lyle the Lizard!
In a nearby cage, Lyle the Lizard hisses!
Mademoiselle, I find that deeply offensive!
Amanda hugs Hector hard! The kitten turns back into a thoroughly squeezed Hector.
Easy, Manda-Panda, not so tight. I need to go to class now.
Hector eases away from her and runs out the door.
Hector is so cute as a kitten! I wish he stayed that way all the time, so I could take him everywhere!
I'd even take him to the `mall` with me!
Though he wouldn't like that as much since he doesn't like the mall.
I'd love to go to the mall with you.
Yay! Turn into a kitten!
No, I... I don't do that... I just like shopping...
Oh, well... That's almost as good...
Let's go!
After school, Amanda and $SUPERZOE meet at the mall.
I love how this place smells!
I do too! It's like how I imagine the inside of a new, leather purse smells!
Or feet inside shoes!
Eww...
Hee hee. Kidding! I'm so excited to have some girl time with you.
I want to go buy stuff now!
An hour later, they walk into the store, `Spinning Tops.` Amanda looks over some cute new shirts.
I'm trying to figure out which one looks good on me.
Amanda holds up two shirts. One is gray and fuzzy. The other is green with sequins.
Which do you think I'll like better?
You'll like the...
Make your choice!
Green one!|Gray one!
You'll like the...
Amanda tries it on and comes back out.
So, what do you think?
I love it! It's grey and fuzzy just like a kitten!
Amanda pets her stomach.
It's just like petting a real kitten! Nice choice, $SUPERZOE!
I'm so glad!
I'm going to buy this right now!
I like green! But the sequins are like scales...
And the scales look like lizard skin! I'm like a lizard! This is so gross!
I'm going to take it off right now!
Guess I should have known she'd like a fuzzy shirt better...
A couple minutes later, Amanda comes out in her normal outfit, carrying a red shirt in her other hand.
So much better! And I even found a cute, `non-green` shirt in the dressing room in just my size!
Let's go pay!
Amanda pays for her shirt. As they're heading out, she sees a huge 'Sale' sign above a shelf of...
`Boots!` Ooh! And they're on `sale!`
Amanda drops her shopping bag on the floor to try on the boots!
But in her excitement, she knocks over the table! Boots fly everywhere, knocking other display cases down!
Oh! I'm sorry, I'll pick all this up!
She picks up a handful of shoes but knocks down a whole row of mannequins!
And when she tries to pick one of the mannequins up, she collides into a rack of jeans!
That's enough! Get out of my store! I should have known better than to let super-powered teenagers in here!
She shoos them out angrily.
And stay out! I don't want to see you around here again!
But... But my shirt!
The saleslady glares at Amanda until she backs away.
She's a mean saleslady... I already paid for my shirt and everything!
You know what? That shirt is yours. I'm going to go in and get it for you.
$SUPERZOE goes invisible, darts into the store, and grabs Amanda's shirt from behind the desk.
She turns to leave the store, but the saleslady strides right at her!
Eep!
What do you do?!
Freeze!|Dodge!|Don't move!
Decide fast!
$SUPERZOE freezes, and the saleslady bumps right into her!
Oh!
$SUPERZOE reappears in the middle of the store.
What are `you` doing back here?!
And what are you holding in your hand? Are you stealing?
$SUPERZOE flees from the store, the bag flying out of her hands as she runs out!
Stop! Thief!
$SUPERZOE runs to Amanda.
Come on, Amanda. We have to run now!
But I hate running!
$SUPERZOE takes her hand and tows Amanda along.
Amanda, can you run a little faster?
Running is not one of my powers!
And it's not my fault you got spotted!
They run past a few more stores before stopping to catch their breath.
I'm sorry, Amanda. Don't worry, it's okay. I think we're safe now.
I can't even hear the saleslady's shouts anymore.
Oh good.
$SUPERZOE dodges the saleslady and leaves the store with the bag in tow!
She reappears beside Amanda.
Hi!
Eep! A ghost!
Amanda, it's just me. I got your bag for you!
You did! Thank you!
No problem. It was your shirt after all.
What do you want to do now? I'm tired of shopping.
Want to grab some coffee?
Is that in the place that smells like burning with the people who wear black, thick-rimmed glasses?
Yes?
Let's go there!
I'm getting a latte. What are you getting?
I have my own special blend that I get. I'm so excited!
Coffee makes me `so` hyper! It's the best!
She jumps up and down, knocking down a stack of cups.
Whoops!
Hm... On second thought, maybe letting Amanda get coffee isn't such a good idea.
Make your choice!
It'll be fun to see Amanda get all crazy!|Suggest decaf.
Maybe this isn't a good idea.
Have you ever tried decaf? It's just like real coffee, except it doesn't make you quite as... Insane.
Well... I could give it a try.
A few minutes later...
Hey! This is kind of nice! I'm drinking coffee... But I can see straight, my hands aren't shaking, and I haven't tried to juggle any of the tables!
And my hands don't even shake!
I want to get decaf all the time!
I knew you'd like it.
I'll have the quadruple espresso with a jar of sugar on the side, please!
Five minutes later...
And then when I was ten I had this cat that had two paws on one foot, and I told everyone it was my baby...
And my mom says I'm a good speller. And my mom says I'm creative...
This is even worse than usual! The coffee has completely removed her ability to think about what she's saying or doing!
You know what? I just feel so energetic all of a sudden, don't you?
I feel like I could run a marathon, or sprint a race, or do cartwheels times infinity!
But I `especially` feel like lifting things!
Amanda lifts the table in front of them with one hand! With the other hand, she grabs another table from nearby! She juggles them!
Look! I'm lifting the same things over and over again!
I think you should put those down.
You're right! I `should` go lift a car!
Or the mall!
Amanda, that could be really dangerous...
Oh fine. You're no fun.
Amanda sets down the tables.
Okay, this officially isn't going well.
Some time later...
So, Amanda, what are your powers exactly?
It's so hard to keep track!
Sometimes I'm super strong, sometimes I'm super indestructible, and sometimes I float!
And I'm getting new powers all the time! Yesterday, I totally counted up to, like, 20x!
Amanda, 20x isn't really a number...
Then why is it in my algebra book?
Uh... Fair enough.
I had a lot of fun with you today!
Me too! You're fun to be around.
...I wish Hector thought that.
What are you talking about?
Before we got our special powers, Hector and I used to be so in love!
But now... It just doesn't feel like he wants to spend time with me anymore.
I'm sure he still loves you. You should talk to him.
I'm going to go home and call him right now...
And tell him about all the times I felt sad at the mall!
Oh...
See you later!
Amanda leaves, and $SUPERZOE pulls out her phone.
I wish this afternoon had gone better. Maybe I can still save my evening though.
And tell him all about my new friend, $SUPERZOE!
Yay!
See you later!
Amanda leaves, and $SUPERZOE pulls out her phone.
That was a great afternoon! Here's hoping my night will be even better!

Hey Howard! What are you doing tonight?
$SUPERZOE
Zoe

Oh, Sam, don't do that in the house.
It's not like I'm doing it on purpose. Ugh.

What's up with Sam? Is she holding an old grudge or something?
Anyway, $SUPERZOE, it is wonderful to see you again. You look so different!
Of course she does, mom. Everyone starts to look different after... Well, you know.
I meant that she looks so mature. But, yes, you just turned fourteen, didn't you?
Just a few days ago...
You must have your powers by now. What can you do?
$SUPERZOE looks down. Aunt Cathy studies $SUPERZOE's face for a moment.
You don't have your powers yet. I can sense your sadness.
But it's all right, dear. They'll come, and then you won't know what to do with yourself!
I didn't get my powers for a week after I turned fourteen. And then everything changed when I became an empath.
An empath?
I can sense other people's feelings. And let me tell you, being a teenager is hard enough! Imagine being a teenager `and` sensing the emotions of every teenager around you!
Now, I can also tell you're distressed about your parents leaving so suddenly to save the European Union from the doomsday comet released by Viktor Von Apocalypse...
But try not to worry. We're going to take good care of you while your parents are away!
Arf!
Oh... And it looks like Puddles still remembers you!
Hey, boy! I missed you!
I missed you too!
Oh! You talk now! When did that happen?
Ever since I ran off to fetch a drooly tennis ball and accidentally got tangled up in one of the neighbor kid's neural amplification nets...
I can talk `and` play chess.
Are you any good?
Not really. I usually get distracted by how chewy the pieces are.
$SUPERZOE, I'm also `sure` you're going to love Centerscore High.
In fact, you're going to get your first taste of it today!
Sam is going to an `emergency cheerleading tryout.` You can come and watch.
She can?
Of course. Go ahead and put your bag in the hallway, $SUPERZOE. You can unpack later.
'Emergency cheerleading tryout?'

So... Uh... What happens now?
Nothing happens now. Don't talk to me. Don't even look at me.
The last thing I need is for you to ruin things when I'm on the verge of becoming a super cheerleader!
But... I don't...
Look, $SUPERZOE, it's nothing personal. I just can't afford to be associated with some lame tomboy who nobody knows and who doesn't even have her powers yet.
I mean... You know how it is, right?
Actually...
Let's face it... You obviously don't know how to dress, can barely speak without mumbling...
